translations.kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
translations.ylt: In many parts, and many ways, God of old having spoken to the fathers in the prophets,
translations.web: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

translations.kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
translations.ylt: in these last days did speak to us in a Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, through whom also He did make the ages;
translations.web: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

translations.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
translations.ylt: who being the brightness of the glory, and the impress of His subsistence, bearing up also the all things by the saying of his might--through himself having made a cleansing of our sins, sat down at the right hand of the greatness in the highest,
translations.web: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

translations.kjv: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
translations.ylt: having become so much better than the messengers, as he did inherit a more excellent name than they.
translations.web: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

translations.kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
translations.ylt: For to which of the messengers said He ever, `My Son thou art--I to-day have begotten thee?' and again, `I will be to him for a father, and he shall be to Me for a son?'
translations.web: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

translations.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
translations.ylt: and when again He may bring in the first-born to the world, He saith, `And let them bow before him--all messengers of God;'
translations.web: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

translations.kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
translations.ylt: and unto the messengers, indeed, He saith, `Who is making His messengers spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire;'
translations.web: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

translations.kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
translations.ylt: and unto the Son: `Thy throne, O God, is to the age of the age; a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy reign;
translations.web: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

translations.kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
translations.ylt: thou didst love righteousness, and didst hate lawlessness; because of this did He anoint thee--God, thy God--with oil of gladness above thy partners;'
translations.web: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

translations.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
translations.ylt: and, `Thou, at the beginning, Lord, the earth didst found, and a work of thy hands are the heavens;
translations.web: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

translations.kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
translations.ylt: these shall perish, and Thou dost remain, and all, as a garment, shall become old,
translations.web: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

translations.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
translations.ylt: and as a mantle Thou shall roll them together, and they shall be changed, and Thou art the same, and Thy years shall not fail.'
translations.web: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

translations.kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
translations.ylt: And unto which of the messengers said He ever, `Sit at My right hand, till I may make thine enemies thy footstool?'
translations.web: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

translations.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
translations.ylt: are they not all spirits of service--for ministration being sent forth because of those about to inherit salvation?
translations.web: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

translations.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
translations.ylt: Because of this it behoveth us more abundantly to take heed to the things heard, lest we may glide aside,
translations.web: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

translations.kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
translations.ylt: for if the word being spoken through messengers did become stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience did receive a just recompense,
translations.web: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

translations.kjv: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
translations.ylt: how shall we escape, having neglected so great salvation? which a beginning receiving--to be spoken through the Lord--by those having heard was confirmed to us,
translations.web: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

translations.kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
translations.ylt: God also bearing joint-witness both with signs and wonders, and manifold powers, and distributions of the Holy Spirit, according to His will.
translations.web: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

translations.kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
translations.ylt: For not to messengers did He subject the coming world, concerning which we speak,
translations.web: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

translations.kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
translations.ylt: and one in a certain place did testify fully, saying, `What is man, that Thou art mindful of him, or a son of man, that Thou dost look after him?
translations.web: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

translations.kjv: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
translations.ylt: Thou didst make him some little less than messengers, with glory and honour Thou didst crown him, and didst set him over the works of Thy hands,
translations.web: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

translations.kjv: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
translations.ylt: all things Thou didst put in subjection under his feet,' for in the subjecting to him the all things, nothing did He leave to him unsubjected, and now not yet do we see the all things subjected to him,
translations.web: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

translations.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
translations.ylt: and him who was made some little less than messengers we see--Jesus--because of the suffering of the death, with glory and honour having been crowned, that by the grace of God for every one he might taste of death.
translations.web: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

translations.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
translations.ylt: For it was becoming to Him, because of whom are the all things, and through whom are the all things, many sons to glory bringing, the author of their salvation through sufferings to make perfect,
translations.web: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

translations.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
translations.ylt: for both he who is sanctifying and those sanctified are all of one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
translations.web: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

translations.kjv: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
translations.ylt: saying, `I will declare Thy name to my brethren, in the midst of an assembly I will sing praise to Thee;' and again, `I will be trusting on Him;'
translations.web: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

translations.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
translations.ylt: and again, `Behold I and the children that God did give to me.'
translations.web: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

translations.kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
translations.ylt: Seeing, then, the children have partaken of flesh and blood, he himself also in like manner did take part of the same, that through death he might destroy him having the power of death--that is, the devil--
translations.web: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

translations.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
translations.ylt: and might deliver those, whoever, with fear of death, throughout all their life, were subjects of bondage,
translations.web: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

translations.kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
translations.ylt: for, doubtless, of messengers it doth not lay hold, but of seed of Abraham it layeth hold,
translations.web: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

translations.kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
translations.ylt: wherefore it did behove him in all things to be made like to the brethren, that he might become a kind and stedfast chief-priest in the things with God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people,
translations.web: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

translations.kjv: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
translations.ylt: for in that he suffered, himself being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
translations.web: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
translations.ylt: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the apostle and chief priest of our profession, Christ Jesus,
translations.web: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

translations.kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
translations.ylt: being stedfast to Him who did appoint him, as also Moses in all his house,
translations.web: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

translations.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
translations.ylt: for of more glory than Moses hath this one been counted worthy, inasmuch as more honour than the house hath he who doth build it,
translations.web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

translations.kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
translations.ylt: for every house is builded by some one, and He who the all things did build is God,
translations.web: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

translations.kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
translations.ylt: and Moses indeed was stedfast in all his house, as an attendant, for a testimony of those things that were to be spoken,
translations.web: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

translations.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
translations.ylt: and Christ, as a Son over his house, whose house are we, if the boldness and the rejoicing of the hope unto the end we hold fast.
translations.web: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

translations.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
translations.ylt: Wherefore, (as the Holy Spirit saith, `To-day, if His voice ye may hear--
translations.web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

translations.kjv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
translations.ylt: ye may not harden your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of the temptation in the wilderness,
translations.web: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

translations.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
translations.ylt: in which tempt Me did your fathers, they did prove Me, and saw My works forty years;
translations.web: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
translations.ylt: wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, Always do they go astray in heart, and these have not known My ways;
translations.web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

translations.kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
translations.ylt: so I sware in My anger, If they shall enter into My rest--!')
translations.web: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

translations.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
translations.ylt: See, brethren, lest there shall be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in the falling away from the living God,
translations.web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

translations.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
translations.ylt: but exhort ye one another every day, while the To-day is called, that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of the sin,
translations.web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

translations.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
translations.ylt: for partakers we have become of the Christ, if the beginning of the confidence unto the end we may hold fast,
translations.web: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

translations.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
translations.ylt: in its being said, `To-day, if His voice ye may hear, ye may not harden your hearts, as in the provocation,'
translations.web: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

translations.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
translations.ylt: for certain having heard did provoke, but not all who did come out of Egypt through Moses;
translations.web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

translations.kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
translations.ylt: but with whom was He grieved forty years? was it not with those who did sin, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?
translations.web: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

translations.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
translations.ylt: and to whom did He swear that they shall not enter into His rest, except to those who did not believe? --
translations.web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

translations.kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
translations.ylt: and we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
translations.web: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

translations.kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
translations.ylt: We may fear, then, lest a promise being left of entering into His rest, any one of you may seem to have come short,
translations.web: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

translations.kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
translations.ylt: for we also are having good news proclaimed, even as they, but the word heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard,
translations.web: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

translations.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
translations.ylt: for we do enter into the rest--we who did believe, as He said, `So I sware in My anger, If they shall enter into My rest--;' and yet the works were done from the foundation of the world,
translations.web: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

translations.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
translations.ylt: for He spake in a certain place concerning the seventh day thus: `And God did rest in the seventh day from all His works;'
translations.web: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

translations.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
translations.ylt: and in this place again, `If they shall enter into My rest--;'
translations.web: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

translations.kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
translations.ylt: since then, it remaineth for certain to enter into it, and those who did first hear good news entered not in because of unbelief--
translations.web: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

translations.kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
translations.ylt: again He doth limit a certain day, `To-day,' (in David saying, after so long a time,) as it hath been said, `To-day, if His voice ye may hear, ye may not harden your hearts,'
translations.web: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

translations.kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
translations.ylt: for if Joshua had given them rest, He would not concerning another day have spoken after these things;
translations.web: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

translations.kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
translations.ylt: there doth remain, then, a sabbatic rest to the people of God,
translations.web: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

translations.kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
translations.ylt: for he who did enter into his rest, he also rested from his works, as God from His own.
translations.web: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

translations.kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
translations.ylt: May we be diligent, then, to enter into that rest, that no one in the same example of the unbelief may fall,
translations.web: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

translations.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
translations.ylt: for the reckoning of God is living, and working, and sharp above every two-edged sword, and piercing unto the dividing asunder both of soul and spirit, of joints also and marrow, and a discerner of thoughts and intents of the heart;
translations.web: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

translations.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
translations.ylt: and there is not a created thing not manifest before Him, but all things are naked and open to His eyes--with whom is our reckoning.
translations.web: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

translations.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
translations.ylt: Having, then, a great chief priest passed through the heavens--Jesus the Son of God--may we hold fast the profession,
translations.web: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

translations.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
translations.ylt: for we have not a chief priest unable to sympathise with our infirmities, but one tempted in all things in like manner--apart from sin;
translations.web: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

translations.kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
translations.ylt: we may come near, then, with freedom, to the throne of the grace, that we may receive kindness, and find grace--for seasonable help.
translations.web: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

translations.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
translations.ylt: For every chief priest--out of men taken--in behalf of men is set in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins,
translations.web: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

translations.kjv: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
translations.ylt: able to be gentle to those ignorant and going astray, since himself also is compassed with infirmity;
translations.web: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

translations.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
translations.ylt: and because of this infirmity he ought, as for the people, so also for himself to offer for sins;
translations.web: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

translations.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
translations.ylt: and no one to himself doth take the honour, but he who is called by God, as also Aaron:
translations.web: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

translations.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
translations.ylt: so also the Christ did not glorify himself to become chief priest, but He who spake unto him: `My Son thou art, I to-day have begotten thee;'
translations.web: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

translations.kjv: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
translations.ylt: as also in another place He saith, `Thou art a priest--to the age, according to the order of Melchisedek;'
translations.web: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

translations.kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
translations.ylt: who in the days of his flesh both prayers and supplications unto Him who was able to save him from death--with strong crying and tears--having offered up, and having been heard in respect to that which he feared,
translations.web: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

translations.kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
translations.ylt: through being a Son, did learn by the things which he suffered--the obedience,
translations.web: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

translations.kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
translations.ylt: and having been made perfect, he did become to all those obeying him a cause of salvation age-during,
translations.web: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

translations.kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
translations.ylt: having been addressed by God a chief priest, according to the order of Melchisedek,
translations.web: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

translations.kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
translations.ylt: concerning whom we have much discourse and of hard explanation to say, since ye have become dull of hearing,
translations.web: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

translations.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
translations.ylt: for even owing to be teachers, because of the time, again ye have need that one teach you what are the elements of the beginning of the oracles of God, and ye have become having need of milk, and not of strong food,
translations.web: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

translations.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
translations.ylt: for every one who is partaking of milk is unskilled in the word of righteousness--for he is an infant,
translations.web: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

translations.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
translations.ylt: and of perfect men is the strong food, who because of the use are having the senses exercised, unto the discernment both of good and of evil.
translations.web: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

translations.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
translations.ylt: Wherefore, having left the word of the beginning of the Christ, unto the perfection we may advance, not again a foundation laying of reformation from dead works, and of faith on God,
translations.web: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

translations.kjv: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
translations.ylt: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on also of hands, of rising again also of the dead, and of judgment age-during,
translations.web: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

translations.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.
translations.ylt: and this we will do, if God may permit,
translations.web: This will we do, if God permits.

translations.kjv: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
translations.ylt: for it is impossible for those once enlightened, having tasted also of the heavenly gift, and partakers having became of the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

translations.kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
translations.ylt: and did taste the good saying of God, the powers also of the coming age,
translations.web: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

translations.kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
translations.ylt: and having fallen away, again to renew them to reformation, having crucified again to themselves the Son of God, and exposed to public shame.
translations.web: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

translations.kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
translations.ylt: For earth, that is drinking in the rain many times coming upon it, and is bringing forth herbs fit for those because of whom also it is dressed, doth partake of blessing from God,
translations.web: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

translations.kjv: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
translations.ylt: and that which is bearing thorns and briers is disapproved of, and nigh to cursing, whose end is for burning;
translations.web: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

translations.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
translations.ylt: and we are persuaded, concerning you, beloved, the things that are better, and accompanying salvation, though even thus we speak,
translations.web: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

translations.kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
translations.ylt: for God is not unrighteous to forget your work, and the labour of the love, that ye shewed to His name, having ministered to the saints and ministering;
translations.web: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

translations.kjv: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
translations.ylt: and we desire each one of you the same diligence to shew, unto the full assurance of the hope unto the end,
translations.web: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

translations.kjv: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
translations.ylt: that ye may not become slothful, but followers of those who through faith and patient endurance are inheriting the promises.
translations.web: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

translations.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
translations.ylt: For to Abraham God, having made promise, seeing He was able to swear by no greater, did swear by Himself,
translations.web: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

translations.kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
translations.ylt: saying, `Blessing indeed I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee;'
translations.web: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

translations.kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
translations.ylt: and so, having patiently endured, he did obtain the promise;
translations.web: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

translations.kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
translations.ylt: for men indeed do swear by the greater, and an end of all controversy to them for confirmation is the oath,
translations.web: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

translations.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
translations.ylt: in which God, more abundantly willing to shew to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, did interpose by an oath,
translations.web: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

translations.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
translations.ylt: that through two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, a strong comfort we may have who did flee for refuge to lay hold on the hope set before us,
translations.web: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

translations.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
translations.ylt: which we have, as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and entering into that within the vail,
translations.web: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

translations.kjv: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
translations.ylt: whither a forerunner for us did enter--Jesus, after the order of Melchisedek chief priest having become--to the age.
translations.web: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

translations.kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
translations.ylt: For this Melchisedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who did meet Abraham turning back from the smiting of the kings, and did bless him,
translations.web: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

translations.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
translations.ylt: to whom also a tenth of all did Abraham divide, (first, indeed, being interpreted, `King of righteousness,' and then also, King of Salem, which is, King of Peace,)
translations.web: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

translations.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
translations.ylt: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, and being made like to the Son of God, doth remain a priest continually.
translations.web: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

translations.kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
translations.ylt: And see how great this one is, to whom also a tenth Abraham the patriarch did give out of the best of the spoils,
translations.web: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

translations.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
translations.ylt: and those, indeed, out of the sons of Levi receiving the priesthood, a command have to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, their brethren, even though they came forth out of the loins of Abraham;
translations.web: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

translations.kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
translations.ylt: and he who was not reckoned by genealogy of them, received tithes from Abraham, and him having the promises he hath blessed,
translations.web: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

translations.kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
translations.ylt: and apart from all controversy, the less by the better is blessed--
translations.web: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

translations.kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
translations.ylt: and here, indeed, men who die do receive tithes, and there he, who is testified to that he was living,
translations.web: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

translations.kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
translations.ylt: and so to speak, through Abraham even Levi who is receiving tithes, hath paid tithes,
translations.web: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

translations.kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
translations.ylt: for he was yet in the loins of the father when Melchisedek met him.
translations.web: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

translations.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
translations.ylt: If indeed, then, perfection were through the Levitical priesthood--for the people under it had received law--what further need, according to the order of Melchisedek, for another priest to arise, and not to be called according to the order of Aaron?
translations.web: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

translations.kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
translations.ylt: for the priesthood being changed, of necessity also, of the law a change doth come,
translations.web: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

translations.kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
translations.ylt: for he of whom these things are said in another tribe hath had part, of whom no one gave attendance at the altar,
translations.web: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

translations.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
translations.ylt: for it is evident that out of Judah hath arisen our Lord, in regard to which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
translations.web: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

translations.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
translations.ylt: And it is yet more abundantly most evident, if according to the similitude of Melchisedek there doth arise another priest,
translations.web: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

translations.kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
translations.ylt: who came not according to the law of a fleshly command, but according to the power of an endless life,
translations.web: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

translations.kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
translations.ylt: for He doth testify--`Thou art a priest--to the age, according to the order of Melchisedek;'
translations.web: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

translations.kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
translations.ylt: for a disannulling indeed doth come of the command going before because of its weakness, and unprofitableness,
translations.web: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

translations.kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
translations.ylt: (for nothing did the law perfect) and the bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw nigh to God.
translations.web: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

translations.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
translations.ylt: And inasmuch as it is not apart from oath, (for those indeed apart from oath are become priests,
translations.web: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

translations.kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
translations.ylt: and he with an oath through Him who is saying unto him, `The Lord sware, and will not repent, Thou art a priest--to the age, according to the order of Melchisedek;')
translations.web: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

translations.kjv: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
translations.ylt: by so much of a better covenant hath Jesus become surety,
translations.web: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

translations.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
translations.ylt: and those indeed are many who have become priests, because by death they are hindered from remaining;
translations.web: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

translations.kjv: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
translations.ylt: and he, because of his remaining--to the age, hath the priesthood not transient,
translations.web: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

translations.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
translations.ylt: whence also he is able to save to the very end, those coming through him unto God--ever living to make intercession for them.
translations.web: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

translations.kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
translations.ylt: For such a chief priest did become us--kind, harmless, undefiled, separate from the sinners, and become higher than the heavens,
translations.web: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

translations.kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
translations.ylt: who hath no necessity daily, as the chief priests, first for his own sins to offer up sacrifice, then for those of the people; for this he did once, having offered up himself;
translations.web: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

translations.kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
translations.ylt: for the law doth appoint men chief priests, having infirmity, but the word of the oath that is after the law appointeth the Son--to the age having been perfected.
translations.web: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

translations.kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
translations.ylt: And the sum concerning the things spoken of is: we have such a chief priest, who did sit down at the right hand of the throne of the greatness in the heavens,
translations.web: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

translations.kjv: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
translations.ylt: of the holy places a servant, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord did set up, and not man,
translations.web: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

translations.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
translations.ylt: for every chief priest to offer both gifts and sacrifices is appointed, whence it is necessary for this one to have also something that he may offer;
translations.web: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

translations.kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
translations.ylt: for if, indeed, he were upon earth, he would not be a priest--(there being the priests who are offering according to the law, the gifts,
translations.web: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

translations.kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
translations.ylt: who unto an example and shadow do serve of the heavenly things, as Moses hath been divinely warned, being about to construct the tabernacle, for `See (saith He) thou mayest make all things according to the pattern that was shewn to thee in the mount;') --
translations.web: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

translations.kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
translations.ylt: and now he hath obtained a more excellent service, how much also of a better covenant is he mediator, which on better promises hath been sanctioned,
translations.web: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

translations.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
translations.ylt: for if that first were faultless, a place would not have been sought for a second.
translations.web: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

translations.kjv: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
translations.ylt: For finding fault, He saith to them, `Lo, days come, saith the Lord, and I will complete with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah, a new covenant,
translations.web: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

translations.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
translations.ylt: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day of My taking them by their hand, to bring them out of the land of Egypt--because they did not remain in My covenant, and I did not regard them, saith the Lord, --
translations.web: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

translations.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
translations.ylt: because this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel, after those days, saith the Lord, giving My laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them, and I will be to them for a God, and they shall be to Me for a people;
translations.web: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

translations.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
translations.ylt: and they shall not teach each his neighbour, and each his brother, saying, Know thou the Lord, because they shall all know Me from the small one of them unto the great one of them,
translations.web: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

translations.kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
translations.ylt: because I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawlessnesses I will remember no more;' --
translations.web: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

translations.kjv: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
translations.ylt: in the saying `new,' He hath made the first old, and what doth become obsolete and is old is nigh disappearing.
translations.web: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

translations.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
translations.ylt: It had, indeed, then (even the first tabernacle) ordinances of service, also a worldly sanctuary,
translations.web: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

translations.kjv: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
translations.ylt: for a tabernacle was prepared, the first, in which was both the lamp-stand, and the table, and the bread of the presence--which is called `Holy;'
translations.web: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

translations.kjv: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
translations.ylt: and after the second vail a tabernacle that is called `Holy of holies,'
translations.web: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

translations.kjv: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
translations.ylt: having a golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid all round about with gold, in which is the golden pot having the manna, and the rod of Aaron that budded, and the tables of the covenant,
translations.web: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

translations.kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
translations.ylt: and over it cherubim of the glory, overshadowing the mercy-seat, concerning which we are not now to speak particularly.
translations.web: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

translations.kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
translations.ylt: And these things having been thus prepared, into the first tabernacle, indeed, at all times the priests do go in, performing the services,
translations.web: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

translations.kjv: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
translations.ylt: and into the second, once in the year, only the chief priest, not apart from blood, which he doth offer for himself and the errors of the people,
translations.web: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

translations.kjv: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
translations.ylt: the Holy Spirit this evidencing that not yet hath been manifested the way of the holy places, the first tabernacle having yet a standing;
translations.web: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

translations.kjv: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
translations.ylt: which is a simile in regard to the present time, in which both gifts and sacrifices are offered, which are not able, in regard to conscience, to make perfect him who is serving,
translations.web: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

translations.kjv: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
translations.ylt: only in victuals, and drinks, and different baptisms, and fleshly ordinances--till the time of reformation imposed upon them.
translations.web: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

translations.kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
translations.ylt: And Christ being come, chief priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands--that is, not of this creation--
translations.web: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

translations.kjv: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
translations.ylt: neither through blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, did enter in once into the holy places, age-during redemption having obtained;
translations.web: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

translations.kjv: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
translations.ylt: for if the blood of bulls, and goats, and ashes of an heifer, sprinkling those defiled, doth sanctify to the purifying of the flesh,
translations.web: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

translations.kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
translations.ylt: how much more shall the blood of the Christ (who through the age-during Spirit did offer himself unblemished to God) purify your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
translations.web: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

translations.kjv: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
translations.ylt: And because of this, of a new covenant he is mediator, that, death having come, for redemption of the transgressions under the first covenant, those called may receive the promise of the age-during inheritance,
translations.web: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

translations.kjv: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
translations.ylt: for where a covenant is, the death of the covenant-victim to come in is necessary,
translations.web: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

translations.kjv: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
translations.ylt: for a covenant over dead victims is stedfast, since it is no force at all when the covenant-victim liveth,
translations.web: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

translations.kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
translations.ylt: whence not even the first apart from blood hath been initiated,
translations.web: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

translations.kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
translations.ylt: for every command having been spoken, according to law, by Moses, to all the people, having taken the blood of the calves and goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, he both the book itself and all the people did sprinkle,
translations.web: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

translations.kjv: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
translations.ylt: saying, `This is the blood of the covenant that God enjoined unto you,'
translations.web: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

translations.kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
translations.ylt: and both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the service with blood in like manner he did sprinkle,
translations.web: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

translations.kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
translations.ylt: and with blood almost all things are purified according to the law, and apart from blood-shedding forgiveness doth not come.
translations.web: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

translations.kjv: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
translations.ylt: It is necessary, therefore, the pattern indeed of the things in the heavens to be purified with these, and the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these;
translations.web: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

translations.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
translations.ylt: for not into holy places made with hands did the Christ enter--figures of the true--but into the heaven itself, now to be manifested in the presence of God for us;
translations.web: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

translations.kjv: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
translations.ylt: nor that he may many times offer himself, even as the chief priest doth enter into the holy places every year with blood of others;
translations.web: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

translations.kjv: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
translations.ylt: since it had behoved him many times to suffer from the foundation of the world, but now once, at the full end of the ages, for putting away of sin through his sacrifice, he hath been manifested;
translations.web: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

translations.kjv: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
translations.ylt: and as it is laid up to men once to die, and after this--judgment,
translations.web: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

translations.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
translations.ylt: so also the Christ, once having been offered to bear the sins of many, a second time, apart from a sin-offering, shall appear, to those waiting for him--to salvation!
translations.web: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

translations.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
translations.ylt: For the law having a shadow of the coming good things--not the very image of the matters, every year, by the same sacrifices that they offer continually, is never able to make perfect those coming near,
translations.web: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

translations.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
translations.ylt: since, would they not have ceased to be offered, because of those serving having no more conscience of sins, having once been purified?
translations.web: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

translations.kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
translations.ylt: but in those sacrifices is a remembrance of sins every year,
translations.web: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

translations.kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
translations.ylt: for it is impossible for blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
translations.web: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

translations.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
translations.ylt: Wherefore, coming into the world, he saith, `Sacrifice and offering Thou didst not will, and a body Thou didst prepare for me,
translations.web: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

translations.kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
translations.ylt: in burnt-offerings, and concerning sin-offerings, Thou didst not delight,
translations.web: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

translations.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
translations.ylt: then I said, Lo, I come, (in a volume of the book it hath been written concerning me,) to do, O God, Thy will;'
translations.web: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

translations.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
translations.ylt: saying above--`Sacrifice, and offering, and burnt-offerings, and concerning sin-offering Thou didst not will, nor delight in,' --which according to the law are offered--
translations.web: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

translations.kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
translations.ylt: then he said, `Lo, I come to do, O God, Thy will;' he doth take away the first that the second he may establish;
translations.web: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

translations.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
translations.ylt: in the which will we are having been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once,
translations.web: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

translations.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
translations.ylt: and every priest, indeed, hath stood daily serving, and the same sacrifices many times offering, that are never able to take away sins.
translations.web: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

translations.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
translations.ylt: And He, for sin one sacrifice having offered--to the end, did sit down on the right hand of God, --
translations.web: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

translations.kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
translations.ylt: as to the rest, expecting till He may place his enemies as his footstool,
translations.web: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

translations.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
translations.ylt: for by one offering he hath perfected to the end those sanctified;
translations.web: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

translations.kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
translations.ylt: and testify to us also doth the Holy Spirit, for after that He hath said before,
translations.web: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

translations.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
