translations.ylt: `This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, giving My laws on their hearts, and upon their minds I will write them,'
translations.web: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

translations.kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
translations.ylt: and `their sins and their lawlessness I will remember no more;'
translations.web: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

translations.kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
translations.ylt: and where forgiveness of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
translations.web: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

translations.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
translations.ylt: Having, therefore, brethren, boldness for the entrance into the holy places, in the blood of Jesus,
translations.web: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

translations.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
translations.ylt: which way he did initiate for us--new and living, through the vail, that is, his flesh--
translations.web: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

translations.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;
translations.ylt: and a high priest over the house of God,
translations.web: and having a great priest over God’s house,

translations.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
translations.ylt: may we draw near with a true heart, in full assurance of faith, having the hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having the body bathed with pure water;
translations.web: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

translations.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
translations.ylt: may we hold fast the unwavering profession of the hope, (for faithful is He who did promise),
translations.web: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

translations.kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
translations.ylt: and may we consider one another to provoke to love and to good works,
translations.web: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

translations.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
translations.ylt: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as a custom of certain is, but exhorting, and so much the more as ye see the day coming nigh.
translations.web: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

translations.kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
translations.ylt: For we--wilfully sinning after the receiving the full knowledge of the truth--no more for sins doth there remain a sacrifice,
translations.web: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

translations.kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
translations.ylt: but a certain fearful looking for of judgment, and fiery zeal, about to devour the opposers;
translations.web: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

translations.kjv: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
translations.ylt: any one who did set at nought a law of Moses, apart from mercies, by two or three witnesses, doth die,
translations.web: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

translations.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
translations.ylt: of how much sorer punishment shall he be counted worthy who the Son of God did trample on, and the blood of the covenant did count a common thing, in which he was sanctified, and to the Spirit of the grace did despite?
translations.web: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

translations.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
translations.ylt: for we have known Him who is saying, `Vengeance is Mine, I will recompense, saith the Lord;' and again, `The Lord shall judge His people;' --
translations.web: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

translations.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
translations.ylt: fearful is the falling into the hands of a living God.
translations.web: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

translations.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
translations.ylt: And call to your remembrance the former days, in which, having been enlightened, ye did endure much conflict of sufferings,
translations.web: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

translations.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
translations.ylt: partly both with reproaches and tribulations being made spectacles, and partly having become partners of those so living,
translations.web: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

translations.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
translations.ylt: for also with my bonds ye sympathised, and the robbery of your goods with joy ye did receive, knowing that ye have in yourselves a better substance in the heavens, and an enduring one.
translations.web: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

translations.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
translations.ylt: Ye may not cast away, then, your boldness, which hath great recompense of reward,
translations.web: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

translations.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
translations.ylt: for of patience ye have need, that the will of God having done, ye may receive the promise,
translations.web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

translations.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
translations.ylt: for yet a very very little, He who is coming will come, and will not tarry;
translations.web: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

translations.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
translations.ylt: and `the righteous by faith shall live,' and `if he may draw back, My soul hath no pleasure in him,'
translations.web: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

translations.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
translations.ylt: and we are not of those drawing back to destruction, but of those believing to a preserving of soul.
translations.web: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

translations.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
translations.ylt: And faith is of things hoped for a confidence, of matters not seen a conviction,
translations.web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

translations.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
translations.ylt: for in this were the elders testified of;
translations.web: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

translations.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
translations.ylt: by faith we understand the ages to have been prepared by a saying of God, in regard to the things seen not having come out of things appearing;
translations.web: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

translations.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
translations.ylt: by faith a better sacrifice did Abel offer to God than Cain, through which he was testified to be righteous, God testifying of his gifts, and through it, he being dead, doth yet speak.
translations.web: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

translations.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
translations.ylt: By faith Enoch was translated--not to see death, and was not found, because God did translate him; for before his translation he had been testified to--that he had pleased God well,
translations.web: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

translations.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
translations.ylt: and apart from faith it is impossible to please well, for it behoveth him who is coming to God to believe that He is, and to those seeking Him He becometh a rewarder.
translations.web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

translations.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
translations.ylt: By faith Noah, having been divinely warned concerning the things not yet seen, having feared, did prepare an ark to the salvation of his house, through which he did condemn the world, and of the righteousness according to faith he became heir.
translations.web: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

translations.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
translations.ylt: By faith Abraham, being called, did obey, to go forth to the place that he was about to receive for an inheritance, and he went forth, not knowing whither he doth go;
translations.web: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

translations.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
translations.ylt: by faith he did sojourn in the land of the promise as a strange country, in tabernacles having dwelt with Isaac and Jacob, fellow-heirs of the same promise,
translations.web: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

translations.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
translations.ylt: for he was looking for the city having the foundations, whose artificer and constructor is God.
translations.web: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

translations.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
translations.ylt: By faith also Sarah herself did receive power to conceive seed, and she bare after the time of life, seeing she did judge Him faithful who did promise;
translations.web: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

translations.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
translations.ylt: wherefore, also from one were begotten--and that of one who had become dead--as the stars of the heaven in multitude, and as sand that is by the sea-shore--the innumerable.
translations.web: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

translations.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
translations.ylt: In faith died all these, not having received the promises, but from afar having seen them, and having been persuaded, and having saluted them, and having confessed that strangers and sojourners they are upon the earth,
translations.web: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

translations.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
translations.ylt: for those saying such things make manifest that they seek a country;
translations.web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

translations.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
translations.ylt: and if, indeed, they had been mindful of that from which they came forth, they might have had an opportunity to return,
translations.web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

translations.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
translations.ylt: but now they long for a better, that is, an heavenly, wherefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for He did prepare for them a city.
translations.web: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

translations.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
translations.ylt: By faith Abraham hath offered up Isaac, being tried, and the only begotten he did offer up who did receive the promises,
translations.web: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

translations.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
translations.ylt: of whom it was said--`In Isaac shall a seed be called to thee;'
translations.web: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

translations.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
translations.ylt: reckoning that even out of the dead God is able to raise up, whence also in a figure he did receive him.
translations.web: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

translations.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
translations.ylt: By faith, concerning coming things, Isaac did bless Jacob and Esau;
translations.web: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

translations.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
translations.ylt: by faith Jacob dying--each of the sons of Joseph did bless, and did bow down upon the top of his staff;
translations.web: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

translations.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
translations.ylt: by faith, Joseph dying, concerning the outgoing of the sons of Israel did make mention, and concerning his bones did give command.
translations.web: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

translations.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
translations.ylt: By faith Moses, having been born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw the child comely, and were not afraid of the decree of the king;
translations.web: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

translations.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
translations.ylt: by faith Moses, having become great, did refuse to be called a son of the daughter of Pharaoh,
translations.web: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

translations.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
translations.ylt: having chosen rather to be afflicted with the people of God, than to have sin's pleasure for a season,
translations.web: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

translations.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
translations.ylt: greater wealth having reckoned the reproach of the Christ than the treasures in Egypt, for he did look to the recompense of reward;
translations.web: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

translations.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
translations.ylt: by faith he left Egypt behind, not having been afraid of the wrath of the king, for, as seeing the Invisible One--he endured;
translations.web: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

translations.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
translations.ylt: by faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that He who is destroying the first-born might not touch them.
translations.web: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

translations.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
translations.ylt: By faith they did pass through the Red Sea as through dry land, which the Egyptians having received a trial of, were swallowed up;
translations.web: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

translations.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
translations.ylt: by faith the walls of Jericho did fall, having been surrounded for seven days;
translations.web: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

translations.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
translations.ylt: by faith Rahab the harlot did not perish with those who disbelieved, having received the spies with peace.
translations.web: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

translations.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
translations.ylt: And what shall I yet say? for the time will fail me recounting about Gideon, Barak also, and Samson, and Jephthah, David also, and Samuel, and the prophets,
translations.web: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

translations.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
translations.ylt: who through faith did subdue kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped mouths of lions,
translations.web: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

translations.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
translations.ylt: quenched the power of fire, escaped the mouth of the sword, were made powerful out of infirmities, became strong in battle, caused to give way camps of the aliens.
translations.web: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

translations.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
translations.ylt: Women received by a rising again their dead, and others were tortured, not accepting the redemption, that a better rising again they might receive,
translations.web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

translations.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
translations.ylt: and others of mockings and scourgings did receive trial, and yet of bonds and imprisonment;
translations.web: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

translations.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
translations.ylt: they were stoned, they were sawn asunder, they were tried; in the killing of the sword they died; they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins--being destitute, afflicted, injuriously treated,
translations.web: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

translations.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
translations.ylt: of whom the world was not worthy; in deserts wandering, and in mountains, and in caves, and in the holes of the earth;
translations.web: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

translations.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
translations.ylt: and these all, having been testified to through the faith, did not receive the promise,
translations.web: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

translations.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
translations.ylt: God for us something better having provided, that apart from us they might not be made perfect.
translations.web: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

translations.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
translations.ylt: Therefore, we also having so great a cloud of witnesses set around us, every weight having put off, and the closely besetting sin, through endurance may we run the contest that is set before us,
translations.web: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

translations.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
translations.ylt: looking to the author and perfecter of faith--Jesus, who, over-against the joy set before him--did endure a cross, shame having despised, on the right hand also of the throne of God did sit down;
translations.web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

translations.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
translations.ylt: for consider again him who endured such gainsaying from the sinners to himself, that ye may not be wearied in your souls--being faint.
translations.web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

translations.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
translations.ylt: Not yet unto blood did ye resist--with the sin striving;
translations.web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

translations.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
translations.ylt: and ye have forgotten the exhortation that doth speak fully with you as with sons, `My son, be not despising chastening of the Lord, nor be faint, being reproved by Him,
translations.web: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

translations.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
translations.ylt: for whom the Lord doth love He doth chasten, and He scourgeth every son whom He receiveth;'
translations.web: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

translations.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
translations.ylt: if chastening ye endure, as to sons God beareth Himself to you, for who is a son whom a father doth not chasten?
translations.web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

translations.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
translations.ylt: and if ye are apart from chastening, of which all have become partakers, then bastards are ye, and not sons.
translations.web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

translations.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
translations.ylt: Then, indeed, fathers of our flesh we have had, chastising us, and we were reverencing them; shall we not much rather be subject to the Father of the spirits, and live?
translations.web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

translations.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
translations.ylt: for they, indeed, for a few days, according to what seemed good to them, were chastening, but He for profit, to be partakers of His separation;
translations.web: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

translations.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
translations.ylt: and all chastening for the present, indeed, doth not seem to be of joy, but of sorrow, yet afterward the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those exercised through it--it doth yield.
translations.web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

translations.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
translations.ylt: Wherefore, the hanging-down hands and the loosened knees set ye up;
translations.web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

translations.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
translations.ylt: and straight paths make for your feet, that that which is lame may not be turned aside, but rather be healed;
translations.web: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

translations.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
translations.ylt: peace pursue with all, and the separation, apart from which no one shall see the Lord,
translations.web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

translations.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
translations.ylt: looking diligently over lest any one be failing of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up may give trouble, and through this many may be defiled;
translations.web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

translations.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
translations.ylt: lest any one be a fornicator, or a profane person, as Esau, who in exchange for one morsel of food did sell his birthright,
translations.web: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

translations.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
translations.ylt: for ye know that also afterwards, wishing to inherit the blessing, he was disapproved of, for a place of reformation he found not, though with tears having sought it.
translations.web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

translations.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
translations.ylt: For ye came not near to the mount touched and scorched with fire, and to blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
translations.web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

translations.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
translations.ylt: and a sound of a trumpet, and a voice of sayings, which those having heard did entreat that a word might not be added to them,
translations.web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

translations.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
translations.ylt: for they were not bearing that which is commanded, `And if a beast may touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or with an arrow shot through,'
translations.web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

translations.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
translations.ylt: and, (so terrible was the sight,) Moses said, `I am fearful exceedingly, and trembling.'
translations.web: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

translations.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
translations.ylt: But, ye came to Mount Zion, and to a city of the living God, to the heavenly Jerusalem, and to myriads of messengers,
translations.web: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

translations.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
translations.ylt: to the company and assembly of the first-born in heaven enrolled, and to God the judge of all, and to spirits of righteous men made perfect,
translations.web: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

translations.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
translations.ylt: and to a mediator of a new covenant--Jesus, and to blood of sprinkling, speaking better things than that of Abel!
translations.web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

translations.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
translations.ylt: See, may ye not refuse him who is speaking, for if those did not escape who refused him who upon earth was divinely speaking--much less we who do turn away from him who speaketh from heaven,
translations.web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

translations.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
translations.ylt: whose voice the earth shook then, and now hath he promised, saying, `Yet once--I shake not only the earth, but also the heaven;'
translations.web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

translations.kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
translations.ylt: and this--`Yet once' --doth make evident the removal of the things shaken, as of things having been made, that the things not shaken may remain;
translations.web: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

translations.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
translations.ylt: wherefore, a kingdom that cannot be shaken receiving, may we have grace, through which we may serve God well-pleasingly, with reverence and religious fear;
translations.web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

translations.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
translations.ylt: for also our God is a consuming fire.
translations.web: for our God is a consuming fire.

translations.kjv: Let brotherly love continue.
translations.ylt: Let brotherly love remain;
translations.web: Let brotherly love continue.

translations.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
translations.ylt: of the hospitality be not forgetful, for through this unawares certain did entertain messengers;
translations.web: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

translations.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
translations.ylt: be mindful of those in bonds, as having been bound with them, of those maltreated, as also yourselves being in the body;
translations.web: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

translations.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
translations.ylt: honourable is the marriage in all, and the bed undefiled, and whoremongers and adulterers God shall judge.
translations.web: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

translations.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
translations.ylt: Without covetousness the behaviour, being content with the things present, for He hath said, `No, I will not leave, no, nor forsake thee,'
translations.web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

translations.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
translations.ylt: so that we do boldly say, `The Lord is to me a helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me.'
translations.web: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
translations.ylt: Be mindful of those leading you, who did speak to you the word of God, whose faith--considering the issue of the behaviour--be imitating,
translations.web: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

translations.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
translations.ylt: Jesus Christ yesterday and to-day the same, and to the ages;
translations.web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

translations.kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
translations.ylt: with teachings manifold and strange be not carried about, for it is good that by grace the heart be confirmed, not with meats, in which they who were occupied were not profited;
translations.web: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

translations.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
translations.ylt: we have an altar, of which to eat they have no authority who the tabernacle are serving,
translations.web: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

translations.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
translations.ylt: for of those beasts whose blood is brought for sin into the holy places through the chief priest--of these the bodies are burned without the camp.
translations.web: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

translations.kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
translations.ylt: Wherefore, also Jesus--that he might sanctify through his own blood the people--without the gate did suffer;
translations.web: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

translations.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
translations.ylt: now, then, may we go forth unto him without the camp, his reproach bearing;
translations.web: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

translations.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
translations.ylt: for we have not here an abiding city, but the coming one we seek;
translations.web: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

translations.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
translations.ylt: through him, then, we may offer up a sacrifice of praise always to God, that is, the fruit of lips, giving thanks to His name;
translations.web: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

translations.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
translations.ylt: and of doing good, and of fellowship, be not forgetful, for with such sacrifices God is well-pleased.
translations.web: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

translations.kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
translations.ylt: Be obedient to those leading you, and be subject, for these do watch for your souls, as about to give account, that with joy they may do this, and not sighing, for this is unprofitable to you.
translations.web: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

translations.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
translations.ylt: Pray for us, for we trust that we have a good conscience, in all things willing to behave well,
translations.web: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

translations.kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
translations.ylt: and more abundantly do I call upon you to do this, that more quickly I may be restored to you.
translations.web: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

translations.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
translations.ylt: And the God of the peace, who did bring up out of the dead the great shepherd of the sheep--in the blood of an age-during covenant--our Lord Jesus,
translations.web: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

translations.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: make you perfect in every good work to do His will, doing in you that which is well-pleasing before Him, through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory--to the ages of the ages! Amen.
translations.web: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
translations.ylt: And I entreat you, brethren, suffer the word of the exhortation, for also through few words I have written to you.
translations.web: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

translations.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
translations.ylt: Know ye that the brother Timotheus is released, with whom, if he may come more shortly, I will see you.
translations.web: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

translations.kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
translations.ylt: Salute all those leading you, and all the saints; salute you doth those from Italy:
translations.web: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

translations.kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen. Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
translations.ylt: the grace is with you all! Amen.
translations.web: Grace be with you all. Amen.
